aggregation.en: ET0 computed for each day (FAO-56 eq. 6, G = 0), then summed per calendar month (mm). A day without every input is missing. A month is reported only when every day of it has a valid daily value; otherwise it is null (no interpolation, ADR-3).

limitations.en: DEV ONLY: development point, not a demo site.
Regional signal: value of the grid cell that contains the site point (about 50-100 km), not a field measurement; no downscaling (ADR-3).
Daily values follow the time standard reported by the API (LST).

Inputs: actual vapour pressure from POWER dewpoint (FAO-56 eq. 14), solar radiation from POWER all-sky shortwave, pressure from POWER surface pressure, elevation of the POWER grid cell (377 m) for clear-sky radiation.
ET0 is the demand of a hypothetical grass reference surface, not the actual evapotranspiration of the crop.
